Threshold Alert
Triggers when the selected metric crosses a fixed value you define.
Baseline Alert
Alerts when current behavior deviates from its usual historical pattern.
Anomaly
Detects unexpected behavior automatically without requiring strict thresholds.
Forecast
Predicts future breaches based on trends and alerts before limits are hit.
